messages:
ajay: Heads-up — POC with Acme.io is stuck. They hit a ModelNotFound/region error when pinning to a specific model and are also seeing intermittent 429s. Security questionnaire still open. Can we swarm?

ajay: Quick context — Acme wants to pin to redwood/redwood-2.0-v1 (we recommended it), region eu-west-1. Their logs show: 
```
POST /v1/generate 200 OK
Request: {
  "model": "redwood/redwood-2.0-v1",
  "input": "..."
}
Response: {
  "error": "ModelNotFoundError: model not available in region eu-west-1"
}
```

ajay: Also seeing bursts of 429s: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
```

emma: @ajay thanks — this is blocking our demo tomorrow. We pinned on purpose for deterministic output. Can we get a clear workaround other than removing the pin?

taylor: Looping in eng-ml + infra. @kevin @lucy — can you confirm whether redwood-2.0-v1 is available in eu-west-1 for hosted customers? If not, what’s the ETA to enable or a recommended alias?

kevin: Quick answer: redwood-2.0 stable variants are in eu-west-1, but the -v1 tag is a customer-namespace pin we deprecated during the rollout. That tag currently maps to an older quantized build we retired. The platform returns ModelNotFound when a pinned tag resolves to a variant not present in the region.

kevin: Workarounds: 1) Pin to the catalog-stable alias e.g. "redwood/redwood-2.0" which is region-aware; 2) Ask us to enable the legacy tag in eu-west-1 (requires a quick infra enablement and a ticket); 3) Use Dedicated pool (no region pinning issue but requires reserved capacity).

emma: Option 1 might change outputs vs v1, is there a measurable delta? They need consistent scores for their eval harness.

kevin: There can be small generation differences between builds. If reproducibility is critical, recommend option 2 (enable legacy tag) so you keep identical binary. We can enable it for the POC window.

lucy: About the 429s — looks like they exceeded the shared-hosting burst quota. Temporary fixes: reduce concurrency on client, add exponential retry (we recommend jittered backoff), or we can temporarily increase their rate limit for the POC. For long-term, switch to Dedicated or request quota bump via the support flow.

ajay: Can we do both: enable legacy tag in eu-west-1 for the next 48 hours and bump their quota for the POC? I’ll take the ask to Acme to accept the change.

lucy: I can open the infra enable ticket now. Will need: customer org id, model tag name (redwood/redwood-2.0-v1), region (eu-west-1), and approval window. Also will set a 48h temporary rate-limit bump (soft cap).

taylor: Security Qs: Acme's infosec asked for encryption at rest and SOC2 docs in the questionnaire. @sec-bot can you paste links to the docs we can share?

sec-bot: SOC2 report: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2 (access requires SSO link)
sec-bot: KMS/HSM docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/kms-hsm
sec-bot: Audit logs and retention options: https://redwood.example.com/docs/audit-logs

emma: Great, please send those. Also confirm whether private VPC deployment option was discussed — their legal wants it written down as an option.

ajay: Action list: 1) lucy to open infra ticket to enable redwood-2.0-v1 in eu-west-1 for 48h and apply temporary rate bump; 2) taylor to send SOC2/KMS links to Acme and capture acceptance; 3) kevin to document any output delta between -v1 and stable alias and snapshot seed details; 4) ajay to confirm with customer on whether pin must be exact or they can accept alias.

lucy: Ticket opened: INFRA-4726. ETA for enablement: 6 hours. Rate bump applied until 2024-05-21T18:00Z.

kevin: I’ll run a quick diff between redwood-2.0-v1 artifacts and redwood-2.0 (stable) on a representative eval set and post numbers here.

ajay: Thanks team — I’ll update Acme and close loop. If anyone needs the org id or sample logs I'll DM. :thumbsup:

emma: Thanks everyone, appreciate the fast turnaround.
